Common objections and how to answer them

takeaways: Pausing a Copilot rollout to fix governance first defers value while orphaned sites, unclassified data and permission drift keep growing.
Automated controls such as SharePoint Advanced Management ownership policies and Purview auto-labeling make governance deterministic instead of dependent on user behavior.
Run remediation and a scoped Copilot deployment in parallel tracks, advancing phases only when predefined adoption, labeling and remediation metrics are met.
hook: Your audit found hundreds of orphaned SharePoint sites and unclassified data, and now the Copilot rollout is on hold. This episode is for IT leaders, architects and governance teams who need to move from not ready to ready enough. Learn how parallel-track governance with SharePoint Advanced Management and Purview lets you deploy Copilot while your governance improves.
